title: 2024 AMC 8 Problem 5
statement: Aaliyah rolls two standard \(6\)-sided dice. She notices that the product of the two numbers rolled is a multiple of \(6.\) Which of the following integers cannot be the sum of the two numbers?

solutions.text:
For the product to be a multiple of \(6\), the two dice together must supply a factor of \(2\) and a factor of \(3\). The possible sums among the answer choices can occur as follows: \[ \begin{gathered} 5=2+3,\quad 7=1+6, \\ 8=2+6,\quad 9=3+6. \end{gathered} \] There is no way to get sum \(6\) while also having a product divisible by \(6\): the pairs with sum \(6\) are \((1,5),\) \((2,4),\) \((3,3),\) \((4,2),\) and \((5,1)\), and none have product divisible by \(6\).

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: A multiple of \(6\) needs a factor of \(2\) and a factor of \(3\)
List the possible sums from dice products divisible by \(6\)
